ENG
Nice to meet you, my name is Shii☆.

I saw the illustration of Belzebute that was delivered and was attracted by how cool it was!

Character
Shinra-Bansho Chocolate Chapter 3, Part 3: Raijin King Ryuga

If possible, I would appreciate it if you could draw it in an atmosphere as if it were in battle. (It is an image of a sword clad in blue lightning that cuts through the enemy! second URL destination, bottom right image.) If you cannot accept the request, we would be very grateful if you would cancel it...!

Thank you in advance if you accept our request.

Thank you in advance if you accept our request.
I'm Shii☆ and I was attracted by the coolness of the illustration of Belzebute when I saw the one you delivered! I would like to make a request!

Character
Shinra-Mannjo Chocolate Chapter 3 Part 3: The Thunderbolt King Ryuga

I would be very happy if you could draw him as if he were in the middle of a battle (I imagine him wearing blue lightning on his sword and cutting through his enemies! I would be very happy if you could draw it as if it were in battle (like the image on the bottom right of the second URL)! If you can't make it, I would appreciate it very much if you could cancel the offer...! If you can't make it, I would appreciate it very much...!

https://shinrabansho.com/archive/3rd_charalist03.html

https://x.com/miroryu/status/1651293446001553409?s=46&t=MduXDQH_9GNzlMeA3nEvqA

Hello there! I liked seeing your fighting game artwork, so I wanted to make a request! 

Would you be willing to draw Kaguya from the Under Night In-Birth series of fighting games? She is a dual-wielding gun user who maintains a positive, doting demeanor while she fights. I've provided some references to her design in the link below:

Kaguya References: https://imgur.com/a/dqIc3lr

Would you be willing to draw her in a pose similar to that linked below? 

Suggested Pose: https://imgur.com/a/eieCN0r

If you are willing to draw some amount of background, I would like to see a night-time, urban setting. Again, it is up to you if you would like to draw a background.

I leave the rest of the composition up to your discretion. Thank you very much for your consideration!

ENG
Thank you for your help. My name is Esty.
I was attracted by an illustration of a Guilty Gear character that appeared on your timeline, and I would like to make a request.
I would like to request a character named "Belzébuth" from a work called Shinra-Bansho-Chocolate.

https://shinrabansho.com/archive/images/05charalist/card02/046.jpg

He is a character with a battle-crazed side who walks around the world in search of the strong. I would be happy if I could imagine him facing a strong enemy who can give his all, with a maniacal smile on his face.
If possible, I would like to see the style of "GG Sol" or "GG Ram" in your portfolio.

We appreciate your consideration.

────────────────────

JPN
お世話になります。エスティーと申します。
タイムラインに流れて参りましたギルティギアキャラクターのイラストに惹かれ、この度依頼させていただきたく思います。
神羅万象チョコという作品より、「ベルゼビュート」というキャラクターをお願いできますでしょうか。

強者を求めて世界中を辺り歩く戦闘狂的側面を持つキャラクターです。自分の全力を出せる強敵を前に、狂気的な笑顔を浮かべ対峙しているようなイメージだと嬉しいです。
もし可能であれば、ポートフォリオを拝見させていただいた中で、「GG Sol」や「GG Ram」の様な画風にしていただければと思います。

ご一考のほどよろしくお願い致します。
